name: Mesh Voxelization
definition: A technique to convert a 3D mesh model in .stl format into voxel center coordinates, sharing the same output export and preview mechanisms as point cloud voxelization.
summary: Mesh Voxelization converts continuous triangular meshes into discrete 3D voxel grids by using ray-mesh intersection tests to determine voxel occupancy, distinguishing it from rasterization or point cloud methods.
